$comment: Live origins that exercise the probes, one row per shape worth learning from. `expect` is coarse on purpose (a verdict per door, a count, a control) so the suite catches an instrument regression without flapping on a site's day-to-day. Recorded 2026-09-16; a row that drifts is either the site changing (update the row, say why) or the probe regressing (fix the probe). Run: node evals/corpus.mjs [--only commerce|auth|skills] [--expect].

commerce.teaches: x402 v2 and MPP on ONE 402 (PAYMENT-REQUIRED + WWW-Authenticate: Payment); x-payment-info in the {price, protocols:[{x402},{mpp}]} shape; paid routes only in /openapi.json, which is why a three-path knock reports it absent
x-payment-info with protocols as STRINGS and a dollar price; rate-limits a burst of knocks (429), which is why the probe knocks three at a time and stops

an API marketplace: the homepage is Markdown naming 40+ per-service /<name>/openapi.json documents in prose (no href); offers[] with method=protocol and rail=payment method and a numeric price at the top
no discovery document at all; the homepage lists routes as `POST /fetch` and the 402 is the only evidence
separate /api/mpp/* and /api/x402/* route families, two openapi documents (/openapi.json and /api/openapi.json), and 401-before-402 on the generic routes
an API host whose / answers 404: measurable (not a wall), sells (x402+mpp), and Cloudflare's scanner refuses it outright with siteError not_found
x402 Bazaar-listed seller that also speaks MPP
the Bazaar's largest single host (25 resources); dual protocol
x402 only, no MPP challenge, no discovery document

a Shopify storefront: UCP profile ships platform-wide (mcp + embedded services, 8 capabilities, 3 payment handlers), the mcp endpoint 301s a GET and answers a JSON-RPC POST, no acp.json, no agent card so no AP2
Shopify platform fingerprint on the homepage but NO /.well-known/ucp: the profile is not on every Shopify domain, so read the door rather than the platform
a UCP-named participant with nothing at /.well-known/ucp on the public storefront; sells by cart and payment signals only
403 to this probe's user-agent while a browser gets 200: unmeasurable, every door unknown, and the ladder says the commerce probe was refused rather than reporting no commerce
a 200 that is a bot-check page: the challenge regex is what makes it unmeasurable
DataDome 403; Cloudflare's scanner also returns siteError blocked here
the reference site: an x402 gate that exists and is unconfigured (x-payment-note), read as maybe; no commerce signal; level 5 elsewhere

auth.teaches: PRM at the path-suffixed /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp, named by the 401 on /mcp; every hop answers
PRM names a hosted issuer (access.stripe.com/mcp) that resolves; the root AS document carries that foreign issuer, which is a note (nothing on the chain points at it) rather than a break
a clean first-party chain: PRM and AS at the root, issuer agrees
PRM resource is the /mcp path rather than the origin
one broken hop: the PRM names accounts.<store>, whose metadata says shopify.com/authentication/<id>; plus the mirrored root AS as a note
the reference: anonymous agent_auth registration answering 201, auth.md with 4 of 4 markers, /mcp answers 405 to a GET so no Bearer challenge on that method
a clean absence: three 404s and a passing ghost control

skills.teaches: 24 skills, every digest verifies, none with frontmatter; and a catch-all under /.well-known/agent-skills/ that answers 200 for a path that cannot exist (the ghost control fails)
the reference: one site skill for a public MCP server
